about.intro: Aaroh Entertainment is an independent music and film company. We write and record original songs, and make the music videos that go with them.
about.story:
In Indian classical music, aaroh is the rising scale: the climb from one note to the next. We work the same way, step by step, from a first idea to a finished song and film.

We started Aaroh because we believe a song and its film should be made together, by the same people, with the same care. So we handle the whole journey ourselves: writing, recording and producing the music, then shooting the video and finishing it in post-production.

We are a new company and only just getting started. If you are an artist, musician, director, cinematographer or editor and want to make something with us, we would love to hear from you.

processSteps.title: Idea
processSteps.text: Every release starts with a song and a picture of the film that could go with it. We develop the two together from the very beginning.

processSteps.title: Demo
processSteps.text: We sketch the song quickly and roughly to find its shape and feel, and the story the video should tell.

processSteps.title: Studio
processSteps.text: Recording, arranging, producing and mixing the final track, so it is ready for release and for the edit.

processSteps.title: Shoot
processSteps.text: We plan and produce the music video around the finished song, with a small crew and a clear idea.

processSteps.title: Edit
processSteps.text: Post-production: cutting the film to the music, then colour grading, sound and finishing.

processSteps.title: Release
processSteps.text: The song and the film come out together on the same day, on streaming services and on YouTube.
